domain_hint: Cementless femoral stem FEA for micromotion under gait loading
ambiguity_notes:
- Use/scope of results: slides alternately claim absolute acceptance against a 40 µm threshold and comparative ranking only.
- Physics choices: contact modeled as full-friction in methods but tied proximally in some validation runs; stem alternately treated as purely elastic and bilinear plastic.
- Discretization quality: one slide asserts <3% change with refinement; numerical values provided later show ~8% change and GCI ~6.8%.
- Solver settings: stated NLGEOM on throughout; a run set note says small-strain used.
- Validation independence: claimed independent dataset; lab log shows same rig/operator used for both tuning and comparison.
- UQ execution: plan states LHS N=100 with uncertainty bounds ±12%; actual runs N=25 usable with wider intervals and corner cases only.
- Software/version control: majority on Abaqus 2021; subset on 2022 with “no impact” asserted but not demonstrated.
